title: Checkout Service High P99 Latency & Connection Pileup
description: Checkout service latency spiked to 35 seconds. Thread pools are exhausted and CPU is at 95% due to thread contention.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Downstream external payment provider (Stripe API) experiencing major service outage; lack of timeout and circuit breaker in checkout-service caused thread exhaustion.
key_evidence: Service topology shows checkout-service depends on external 'stripe-api'
Topology downstream health shows stripe-api status as 'UNHEALTHY'
Logs show read timeouts when contacting https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges
No deployments to checkout-service in past 72 hours
distractors: CPU usage on checkout-service is 95% (symptom of thread contention, not the cause)

logs.message: Slow response from payment provider: 28400ms for charge_req_81
Read timed out connecting to https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges
Worker thread pool reached 100% capacity (500/500 threads blocked)
